data.text: Welcome, Luke! My family taught me to leave enough fish for next season—the village depends on this lake. I propose 10 tons each this month: that’s $10,000 apiece, and the lake can refill to 100 tons. If someone wants less, we can agree beforehand to reassign their unused share, keeping our total at 50. I’ll stick to 10. John, does that work for you?
